changeSet.comment: Owner-read SELECT policy catalog_owners_owner_read on nexus.catalog_owners for the migrating role (RDR-246): skipped whole (MARK_RAN) when nexus_svc, or any other login role subject to row-level security, is or inherits the migrating role; ends with a post-condition that RAISEs unless the policy names exactly the migrating role.

rollback.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS catalog_owners_owner_read ON nexus.catalog_owners
